text: 🩹 Cage keeper: "Hey kid, here. Train safely." HP full; bleeds and poisons cleared. The keeper does this after every win here while your six attributes total {cap} or less.
🩹 The cage keeper patches you up: HP full.
⏸️ The cage keeper stops the cages: a {name} is up. Play is held until you answer; the time is banked as bonus time.
⚔️ You step in with the {name}. No fleeing, and no patching up until it is over.
You pass on the {name}. The cages carry on; the keeper asks again after {every} more wins.
